draftNote: 1 of five queued off a bottom-two lane: Mr_Meat31 (support→offlane).

coaching.headline: A win taken through the fights — we lost the neutral objectives 16–29 and the 10-minute Fangtooth, but out-towered them 8–7 while Gadget (10/5/9) and Legion (10/4) took over.
coaching.team: No healers on either side, so itemization was free. We lost the objective war badly (16–29) yet won because Willy's Gadget (10/5/9) and Goldilocks' Legion (10/4) took over the fights — despite carry reading theirs all game — and we converted to towers, 8–7. That's fragile — group the Fangtooth more and the hero games aren't needed. Tower conversion is what saved it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Contest the Fangtooth as a group — we gave the early ones and only the lane leads bailed us out. Convert those leads to objectives, not just kills.

perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gadget mid (10/5/9) carried the lane and snowballed — but the team lost the objective war (16-29) Willy should be calling as lead; convert lane leads to neutrals sooner.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Legion went 10/4 despite a carry read 'theirs all game' vs Sparrow — 42604 objective damage and the fight wins are what bailed out the lost objective war (16-29).
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Greystone held a favored offlane read into Murdock — a solid hold that helped out-tower them 8-7.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase support (0/4/11) — good low-death enabling (11 assists); the loss to fix was the objective war (16-29), not Mr_Meat31's lane.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Khaimera on Xeebs' lane and favored, 1/7 — Xeebs enables (13 assists) but needs to win neutrals, which we lost 16–29.

synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
ourKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
ourKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
ourKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
enemyKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
enemyKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
enemyKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
enemyKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash → Hamstring slows → Safeguard spellshield → Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with the spellshield up and execute low targets with Earth Shatter
enemyKits.passive: permanent power on unique hero takedowns
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's spellshield before committing the key CC

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

checks.text: No real tank: nobody to start fights or take the first hits for the backline.
Out-tanked 0 v 1: teams one tank down won 48.1% in 1.18.
2 divers (Greystone, Khaimera): each one past the first is a hero not holding the line.
One main mage and one main marksman at most.
Phase can stay with the carry and peel.

teamComp.summary: Draft: 0 tanks, 2 divers vs their 1 tank, 1 diver. In 1.18 ranked, our shape won 48.3% and theirs 50.5%.

cc.note: Crowd control was close: 6 hard-CC abilities for us, 7 for them.

kit: Hard CC: Black Hole (pull), Cosmic Power (root).
threat.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst
answers: Magical armor on whoever it kept killing.
Tenacity on the players it caught.

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Vesh. Gideon has 3 damaging abilities (Void Breach, Cosmic Rift, Black Hole hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 38 ability haste brought them back 28% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Azure Core, Wraith Leggings. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Soulbearer, Lich.
The Eternal was part of it: Vesh (Lich + Millennia) sits on the same triggers as the items (every ability hit set off; healing off the damage), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Gideon killed built magical armor (Phase). No anti-heal on the team against a build that heals. We killed Gideon 5 times.
Copy it? Vesh: 49.2% in 6,330 Gideon midlane games, level with the hero's 48.6%; this 3-item core: 67.4% in 95 games, above the 52.6% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Black Hole came back about every 76s instead of 105s by the end (28% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

loadout.name: Press the Advantage
loadout.text: Upon achieving a Takedown, a Rally Point is spawned at the dead Targets location. Rally Point no longer grants Health Regeneration but increases Legions Rate of Fire by 14/18/22/26/30% and grants Allies 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Attack Speed.

ability.name: Rally Point
ability.what: Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20%) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies.

loadout.plain: Every takedown drops a free Rally Point where the enemy died. It stops healing but speeds up your rifle and your team's attacks, so one kill in a teamfight snowballs into the next.

loadout.name: Vermis
loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Every third rifle shot in a row on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Legion fires fast, so it procs often and is strongest into tanky frontliners.

loadout.name: Serration
loadout.text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Your Vermis shots also hit harder the more health the target is missing, so the rifle finishes wounded heroes faster late in a fight.

loadout.name: Melting Point
loadout.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
loadout.plain: Bonus damage only against heavily armored targets, so it matters when the enemy tank or bruiser stacks armor. Into squishy teams it does nothing.

loadout.name: Ortus
loadout.text: Limit Breaker:  Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
loadout.plain: Pop it as a fight starts for speed and extra physical power. Takedowns during it refresh the timer and add permanent power, so use it before Orbital Sanction lands on a grouped team.
